{{Top|leg}}
'''Treasurer''' was a title used by various factions. In the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]],<ref name="RG147">{{InsiderCite|147|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Devious Neimoidians Revealed}}</ref> those who held the title were charged with the treasury department of the Federation, and thus oversaw its financial affairs.<ref name="SWS">{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/creating-naming-the-devious-neimoidians/676129629103814|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=Jan 19, 2014|archivefile=File:NeimoidiansFacebook.pdf}}</ref> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Subjugation of Naboo]], the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Hap Brehg]] was made treasurer of the [[Trade Federation Occupation Council|Occupation Council]].<ref name="RG147" /> In [[Geelan]] society, each individual nest included a treasurer to help manage the group's business affairs.<ref name="ZA">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref>
